title: WRCC2023-MI-C
description: Three-class motor imagery EEG dataset (left hand, right hand, feet) from the MI-C track of the 2023 World Robot Contest BCI competition. It includes 8 participants, two of whom are stroke patients, each completing 90 cue-based offline trials. Data were recorded with a 59-channel EEG montage at 1000 Hz and are distributed in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuracle NeuSen W 64-channel wireless system (59 EEG channels used, standard_1005 montage) at 1000 Hz with 50 Hz line frequency. Participants performed cue-based motor imagery of left hand, right hand, or feet (30 trials per class), with 4 s epochs per trial, each stored as a separate run.
